Container.Name: weather-scout
Container.Overview: Weather Scout: a kid-friendly family weather station with a radar loop, NWS alerts, state 511 road cameras on a map, a Kid Zone with Rocky the raccoon, your own Ecowitt, Ambient or Tempest weather station, and Home Assistant sensors over MQTT. API keys stay on your server. Everything else (home place, camera keys, AI helper, Rocky's voice, weather stations, Home Assistant, Windy, push alerts) is set inside the app: sign in as the admin and open Family & settings. Older installs keep working with their existing variables; values saved in the app win over them.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Database (including everything set in Family & settings), cameras.json and caches

Config.Name: Require sign-in
Config.Description: true = must sign in to see anything. Kept here (not in the app) so a wrong setting can never lock you out.

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: Optional. Creates the first admin on start. Leave blank to create the admin on first visit instead.

Config.Name: Trust tinyauth headers
Config.Description: Only true when the app is reachable ONLY through tinyauth/your reverse proxy. The SSO sign-out link is set in the app.
